sourceClaims.claim: 133 source SVGs map to 119 logical glyphs and 125 emitted variants without geometry or paint loss.
97 logical monochrome icons use currentColor and 22 preserve source paint.
Explicit compatibility aliases preserve historical names without becoming canonical glyphs.
Uncertain source labels remain explicitly uncertain and are not silently merged.

evidence.source-integrity: pass: hash and element-level paint tests cover all 133 source SVGs and retain 119 logical glyphs, 125 emitted variants, and explicit uncertain names
evidence.structural-contract: pass: tests verify 97 currentColor and 22 preserved-paint logical icons, unique canonical names, 42 explicit aliases, sprite symbols, runtime helpers, and package exports
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: the icon catalog resolves all 119 canonical symbols to non-empty painted browser geometry
evidence.accessibility: not-applicable: the icon package supplies geometry and paint but no semantic meaning; accessible names and decorative treatment remain consumer-level claims
evidence.focused-visual: pass: a focused nine-icon snapshot covers representative currentColor, preserved-paint, container, state-family, and file-type topologies
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: representative controls verify currentColor inheritance, preserved-paint assets are not recolored, and plain HTML consumes the published sprite/assets
evidence.responsive-content-stress: not-applicable: intrinsic icon geometry is viewport-independent

limitations: Consumer-specific accessible names remain the consumer contract.
